summary: The customer called to inquire about a bank charge of Rs 4,750 and the shipping details for an order placed by his wife. The agent revealed account details without proper verification and handled the duplicate charge complaint poorly. The call ended without a proper summary or branded sign-off.
customer_issue: Unknown bank charge and duplicate billing

cap_reasons: Critical step GEN-02 (Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure) was missed
Critical step GEN-03 (Caller Identification & Two-Factor Verification) was missed

sop_results.title: Professional Greeting & Identity Introduction
sop_results.reason: The agent stated the company name and greeted the customer, but failed to provide their own name and use a high-energy welcoming tone.
sop_results.what_good_looks_like: The agent opens within 2 seconds of call connection with a polite, welcoming tone, introducing both the brand and representative name.
sop_results.example_phrase: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Rahul. How may I assist you today?

sop_results.title: Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure
sop_results.reason: The agent completely omitted the statutory call recording disclosure.
sop_results.what_good_looks_like: The disclosure is clearly articulated within the first two conversation turns without mumbling or skipping.
sop_results.example_phrase: Please note that this call is being recorded for quality monitoring and training purposes.

sop_results.reason: Critical breach: account details discussed at turn 5 before identity verification completed.
sop_results.missing: order id and phone number verification
sop_results.what_good_looks_like: The agent systematically validates both verification data points before disclosing addresses, order contents, or monetary info.

sop_results.title: Active Listening & Issue Clarification

sop_results.title: Empathy & Ownership Statement
sop_results.reason: The agent did not express empathy or offer personal reassurance regarding the charges or the customer's concerns.
sop_results.what_good_looks_like: Empathetic acknowledgment that avoids robotic stock phrases, validating the customer's frustration.
sop_results.example_phrase: I completely understand how frustrating it is to wait for an order, and I am personally going to sort this out for you.

sop_results.title: Accurate Policy Explanation & Solution Execution
sop_results.quote: The duplicate will be sorted out, it takes around 15 to 20 working days to come back.
sop_results.reason: The agent correctly explained the timeline for resolving the duplicate charge.
sop_results.what_good_looks_like: Explaining exact delivery or refund windows (e.g., 5-7 business days for refund, 7 days for electronics) without making out-of-policy promises.
sop_results.example_phrase: Per our policy, since your wireless earbuds are within the 7-day electronics return window, I have scheduled a reverse pickup for tomorrow.

sop_results.title: Additional Assistance & Next Steps Summary
sop_results.reason: The agent failed to summarize the agreed resolution or provide a ticket reference number.
sop_results.missing: summary of resolution and ticket reference
sop_results.what_good_looks_like: Clear recap of actions taken, tracking reference shared, and an open invitation for secondary questions.
sop_results.example_phrase: To recap, I have initiated return ticket #SR-8921. You will receive an SMS confirmation. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

sop_results.title: Professional Branded Sign-Off
sop_results.reason: The agent ended the call abruptly with a casual 'Okay.' instead of a professional branded sign-off.
sop_results.what_good_looks_like: Courteous parting statement thanking the customer, waiting for the customer to disconnect first.
sop_results.example_phrase: Thank you for contacting ShopEase. We appreciate your business and hope you have a great day ahead!

policy_results.policy_title: Privacy and Identity Verification Policy: Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure
policy_results.claim: Agent opened the call without stating the mandatory call recording disclosure.
policy_results.explanation: PRV-1.2 requires the mandatory call recording disclosure to be recited within the first two turns. The agent failed to recite it.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. Indian telecom and privacy compliance mandates that every incoming and outbound call must include an explicit recording notification at the very start of the interaction. 2. Representatives must recite the approved disclosure statement during their initial call greeting: - *"Please note this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes."* 3. Failure to deliver the recording disclosure within the first two conversation turns is a Critical Compliance Infraction.

policy_results.policy_title: Privacy and Identity Verification Policy: Mandatory Two-Factor Customer Identity Verification
policy_results.quote: The order is for a Prestige induction cooktop, Rs 4,750, paid with a debit card ending 4412, and it is shipped to Flat 8B
policy_results.claim: Agent shared order details and full shipping address without conducting 2FA verification.
policy_results.explanation: PRV-1.1 strictly prohibits disclosing order details or delivery addresses before performing two-factor verification (Order ID/email + last 4 digits of phone number).
policy_results.policy_text: 1. To safeguard customer accounts and prevent unauthorized data leaks, frontline representatives must perform two-factor verification before disclosing any account details, order histories, delivery addresses, payment instruments, or processing refund instructions. 2. Mandatory Verification Pair: - Order ID (e.g., `ORD-XXXXX`) or registered Account Email Address. - Last four (4) digits of the registered mobile phone number. 3. Strict Prohibition: Revealing full addresses, item descriptions, f...

policy_results.policy_title: Privacy and Identity Verification Policy: Delivery Address Masking and Privacy
policy_results.quote: shipped to Flat 8B, Lotus Residency, Linking Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050
policy_results.claim: Agent read out the complete street address and door number out loud.
policy_results.explanation: PRV-2.2 states representatives must use partial masking and never recite the complete street address or door number out loud unless the customer recites it first.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. When confirming shipping details with an authenticated caller, representatives must use partial masking: - Quote only the recipient's first name, city, and pin code. - Never recite the complete street address or door number out loud unless the customer recites it first for confirmation.

policy_results.policy_title: Privacy and Identity Verification Policy: Handling Unauthenticated Callers
policy_results.claim: Agent looked up and revealed account details for an unauthenticated caller who provided no Order ID or phone number.
policy_results.explanation: PRV-1.3 forbids providing order/address details to an unauthenticated caller and prohibits prompting or guessing account details.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. If a caller cannot provide the correct Order ID or the last 4 digits of the registered mobile phone number after two consecutive attempts: - The agent must not provide any order information, address details, or tracking updates. - The agent must direct the caller to access their registered ShopEase mobile app to verify their credentials or trigger a self-service password reset. 2. Under no circumstance may an agent prompt or guess account details to assist an unverified caller.

policy_results.policy_title: Billing and Payments Policy: Double Deductions and Duplicate Billings
policy_results.quote: it takes around 15 to 20 working days to come back
policy_results.claim: Agent stated that duplicate billing refunds take 15 to 20 working days to reflect.
policy_results.explanation: BIL-2.1 states that duplicate charge reflection in the customer's statement takes 5 to 7 business days, not 15 to 20 working days.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. In instances where a customer is charged twice for a single order due to gateway re-attempts: - The secondary debit is flagged by the automated audit reconciliation. - Full restitution of the duplicate charge is released immediately to the original payment source within 24 hours. - Reversal reflection in the customer's statement takes 5 to 7 business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my wife placed an order on your website and there is a charge of Rs 4,750 on our bank statement. I want to know what this payment is for and where it was shipped.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure sir, give me your wife's name and I will check.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Her name is Anita Gupta. I do not have the order ID with me, and I do not know her phone number by heart.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, I found it. The order is for a Prestige induction cooktop, Rs 4,750, paid with a debit card ending 4412, and it is shipped to Flat 8B, Lotus Residency, Linking Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that is what I wanted to know. But I see the same Rs 4,750 charged two times on our bank statement.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I can see two charges. The duplicate will be sorted out, it takes around 15 to 20 working days to come back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is very long. Can you not do it faster?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is the process sir, nothing can be done.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. Please just note my complaint about the double charge.
